text:
Elena Ruiz: Hi team  quick question. I used the corp card at a cafe during an all-day offsite. The receipt shows a single charge of $128.40 for a table of 6 (catering + drinks). My manager approved my attendance but I only need reimbursement for my portion $21.40. The cafe provided a stamped bill but didn't split it. How should I submit?

Tom Becker: Hi @Elena  thanks. If the merchant cannot provide a split, finance accepts the stamped bill plus a short note from the event organiser confirming individual share. Can you get either a written note or a photo of the organiser's approval?

Elena Ruiz: I can upload the stamped bill and the Google doc where the organiser (Maya) listed attendee shares. Uploading both now: [cafe_bill_2024-09-22.jpg], [offsite_split_sheet.pdf].

Maya Shah: Confirming I organised the table for the offsite and recorded each attendee's share in the doc. Elena's share is $21.40 (no alcohol). Approving reimbursement.

expenses-bot: Policy check: group meal split requires either an itemized split from vendor OR organiser attestation. Tip included on the card (12%) is allowed. Please ensure expense type is "Travel: Meals - Group" and note attendees.

Finance Ops: For audit, tag this as MEALS-GROUP-2024 and vendor "Local cafe (non-itemized)". We'll reimburse only Elena's portion $21.40 and disallow any personal alcohol line items. Please add attendee names in Ramp notes.

Elena Ruiz: Done  uploaded doc and added attendees in Ramp. Thanks!

expenses-bot: Expense queued. Reference EXP-9933. Estimated reimbursement: 21.40 USD.
